name: Buffet Made-to-Order Omelet & Soft Scrambled Eggs
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Fresh-cracked eggs cooked to order with diced ham and aged cheddar or Swiss provide 20g+ of zero-fiber protein to anchor a cruise morning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Step up to the omelet window at Cabanas or Marceline Market and order a plain, ham-and-cheddar, or Swiss omelet (strictly no raw diced onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, or mushrooms). Pair with a white bagel, croissant, or hash brown inside.
watchOuts: Pre-mixed liquid buffet scrambled eggs if they contain dairy cream (use the fresh omelet station if lactose sensitive)
